claims.evidence: Generic marketing statement; photos only show a scuffed, dirty used barrel with no close-up of lid seal, interior, or structural integrity to support 'quality' claim.

risks.risk: Drum capacity/volume unknown, affects base value
risks.proof: Photo showing embossed liter marking on the barrel body or a tape-measure shot of height/diameter
risks.if_unproven: priced as smallest common size for this drum shape

risks.risk: Interior condition unknown (residue, rust stains, odor, prior chemical contents)
risks.proof: Photo/video of the open interior with lid removed, including base and seams

risks.risk: Lid seal and bung caps may not be airtight/functional
risks.proof: Video of lid closing and clasps engaging, plus close-up of bung threads
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-sealing, water/odor leakage likely

risks.proof: Close-up of any recycling/food-grade stamp molded into the plastic
risks.if_unproven: priced as industrial-use only, not for food/water storage

risks.risk: Hidden cracks or damage on base/underside
risks.proof: Photo of the barrel tipped over showing the full base

risks.risk: Faded green paint marks may indicate prior chemical/hazardous labeling
risks.proof: Close-up clear shot of the paint marks and any stenciled text beneath grime
risks.if_unproven: priced as ex-chemical drum, discounted for contamination risk

proof_requests: Video of the barrel opened with interior fully visible, including base
Close-up of any embossed capacity/volume marking
Photo of the barrel tipped to show the full underside
Close-up of lid clasps and bung caps demonstrating they seal
Close-up of the faded green paint marks and any stenciled text
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a used plastic barrel with lid, so it can be priced at worst case (unknown capacity, unverified interior/food-grade status, possible prior chemical use) pending the listed proofs; the seller's statement is pure marketing and adds no verifiable information.
